description: Bounded replay of the chapter's centralized GOC-MCDS-C maximal-independent-set and distance-three connector stages.

source.title: Routing-Cost Constrained Connected Dominating Set
source.algorithm_attribution: GOC-MCDS-C centralized construction; MISI follows the chapter's unique-ID local-minimum rounds
source.implementation_status: clean-room bounded trace; deterministic ID and shortest-path tie rules

input.adjacency_masks: symmetric loop-free masks over vertices 0..n-1; graph must be connected
input.node_ids: distinct positive IDs used by MISI and shortest-path tie breaking

workspace.meaning: Fixed adjacency, BFS, queue, and set-mask state for at most eight vertices.

contract.stage_one: Repeat synchronous MISI rounds: every white vertex with the smallest ID among its white neighbors turns black; white neighbors of black vertices turn gray.
contract.stage_two: For each MIS pair at graph distance at most three, add the internal vertices of one shortest path to the connector set.
contract.shortest_path_tie_rule: Among shortest paths, choose the lexicographically smallest node-ID sequence; consider MIS pairs in ascending node-ID order.
contract.result: Return the MIS mask and the union of the MIS and all selected path interiors.
contract.scope: The chapter's unit-disk approximation and routing-stretch guarantees are not claimed for this graph-only profile; distributed Algorithm 3 is excluded.
